name: DRO Ensemble of T/Beta/Platt + Bootstrap Shrinkage
tagline: Ensembles temperature, beta, and Platt calibrators with DRO-tilted weights minimizing worst-group ECE-gap; group temperatures shrunk by bootstrap variance.
init_recovers: Global temperature scaling when w → [1,0,0] and groups absent
diff_from_baseline: Versus group_temperature_scaling, builds three parametric calibrators (T, Platt, beta), shrinks per-group T using bootstrap variance, then DRO-fits global ensemble weights minimizing worst-group ECE plus max-min gap; per-group ensemble weights are shrunk back toward the DRO global.

name: Beta + Per-Sample Group/Global Blend
tagline: Global beta calibrator plus per-group beta calibrators; predictions blend via a per-sample weight that shrinks with group size and probability proximity to the group mean.
formula: $$\mathrm{cal}_{\mathrm{global}}(p) = \sigma(\theta_0 + \theta_1\log p + \theta_2\log(1-p)),\qquad \mathrm{cal}_g(p)\,\text{analogous},$$ $$z_i = \min\!\Big(\tfrac{|p_i - \bar p_g|}{\hat\sigma_g}, 3\Big),\quad w_i = \tfrac{n_g}{n_g + 50}\cdot\big(1 - z_i/3\big)_+,$$ $$\hat p_i = w_i\,\mathrm{cal}_g(p_i) + (1 - w_i)\,\mathrm{cal}_{\mathrm{global}}(p_i).$$
init_recovers: Beta calibration baseline when groups absent or all w_i = 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus beta_calibration, additionally fits a per-group beta calibrator, then blends per-sample with the global model using a weight that combines size shrinkage (n_g/(n_g+50)) and how close p_i is to that group's mean prob (≥3σ → fall back to global).

name: Group Isotonic + Shrinkage + Base-Rate Smoothing
tagline: Per-group isotonic regression blended with global isotonic via James-Stein shrinkage, plus a 5% smoothing toward each group's base rate.
formula: $$\hat p_g(p) = \alpha_g\,\mathrm{Iso}_g(p) + (1-\alpha_g)\,\mathrm{Iso}(p),\quad \alpha_g = \tfrac{n_g}{n_g + k},\ k = 100,$$ $$\hat p_{\mathrm{out}} = 0.95\,\hat p_g(p) + 0.05\,\hat\pi_g + 10^{-5}\,p,\qquad \hat\pi_g = \mathrm{clip}(\bar y_g,\,0.05, 0.95).$$

key_hyperparams.name: min_group_size_for_iso
key_hyperparams.role: skip iso fit below; min 5 to record base rate

key_hyperparams.name: base_rate_weight
key_hyperparams.role: weight of group prior in final smoothing

init_recovers: Global isotonic when no groups or α_g = 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus isotonic_regression, fits a per-group isotonic on top, blends them via α = n_g/(n_g+100), then smooths the result 95/5 toward each group's clipped base rate (small monotonic tie-break also added).

name: Iso(T) + Smoothed Per-Bin Subgroup Δ-Table
tagline: Global = isotonic on temperature-scaled logits; subgroups get a 7-bin probability-space residual table, shrunk by support and roughness, applied where binning has support.

key_hyperparams.name: roughness penalty
key_hyperparams.role: extra shrinkage for rough Δ tables

key_hyperparams.name: proximity_radius
key_hyperparams.role: controls how fast confidence falls off bin center

init_recovers: Global isotonic + temperature when all Δ tables are empty
diff_from_baseline: Versus group_temperature_scaling / isotonic, keeps a single strong global calibrator (T then iso) and adds an additive, support-weighted per-bin subgroup residual table that is shrunk by both n_g and Δ-roughness, then applied with per-sample proximity weighting.

name: Minimax-ECE Temperature + Greedy Group Δ
tagline: Global T chosen by grid-search to minimize worst-group ECE; each group's T is a shrinkage blend kept only if it improves overall ECE on calibration data.

key_hyperparams.name: selection criterion (B)
key_hyperparams.role: accept local T only if global ECE drops

init_recovers: Global temperature scaling when every group falls back to T*
diff_from_baseline: Versus group_temperature_scaling, picks the global T by minimax-ECE grid search (not NLL) and chooses per-group temperature by greedy ECE-improvement: each group's T is a shrinkage blend whose α is selected only if it cuts the overall calibration ECE.
